subject: Request: Quick reference + one-pager approval (Sparklytics)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Erik Johnson <erik.johnson@sparklytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Quick reference + one-pager approval (Sparklytics)

Hi Erik —

Quick note: congrats on the launch last week, the demo looked great. Wed like to feature Sparklytics as a one-pager customer highlight for our enterprise sales deck and a shortened testimonial for our website. 

Would you be open to:
- A short 1-2 sentence quote we can attribute to you (or a named contact)
- Permission to use Sparklytics logo and a single metric (e.g., "3x throughput, 42% infra cost reduction")
- A quick review/approval of the attached draft one-pager (PDF)

Were aiming for internal enablement assets: a one-pager + a 1-slide summary + two 15s soundbites for our sales reps. If youd like, we can share a canary slide before anything goes public. Estimated timeline: wed love approvals by EOD Monday 5/20 so our Q3 playbook can include Sparklytics.

Attached: draft_onepager_v1.pdf (wording & logo placement).

Thanks — really appreciate your partnership.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Lead, Customer Stories
Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com

From: Erik Johnson <erik.johnson@sparklytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Quick reference + one-pager approval (Sparklytics)

Sofia —

Happy to help, and congrats to your team as well on the new release. High level: Sparklytics has seen ~3x increase in inference throughput on our core ranking pipeline since migrating to Redwood, and were running ~42% lower token spend vs. the prior hosted endpoint (same quality). Were OK with the use of the logo and the headline metric above.

Im attaching a clean logo file and a two-line pull quote you can use. For legal: Ill loop in our marketing manager if you need a formal permission letter, but for sales enablement wem fine with this level of attribution.

Attachments: sparklytics_logo.svg, erik_quote.txt

—
Erik Johnson
CTO, Sparklytics
erik.johnson@sparklytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Erik Johnson <erik.johnson@sparklytics.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Quick reference + one-pager approval (Sparklytics)

Thanks so much Erik — really appreciate the quick turnaround.

Erik, two quick asks from our side if possible:
1) Could you confirm whether the metric (3x throughput, 42% cost) can be shown as a percentage or should remain anonymized? We usually show exact percent unless customers request otherwise.
2) Would you be willing to provide a 15–20 word variant of the quote specifically for our sales rep script? Something like: “Redwoods runtime tripled throughput for our ranking model while cutting token costs by ~40%.” If youre short on time, we can draft and send for approval.

I attached an updated one-pager (onepager_sparklytics_v2.pdf) with tightened copy and suggested pull-out stat. If all good Ill move this into the internal sales slide pack and mark as approved.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Enablement
Redwood Inference

Ben / Sofia — fine to publish the numbers as-is (we track that internally and are comfortable with the attribution). For the short script: please use the line below (feel free to shorten):

"Redwoods inference runtime tripled throughput for our ranking model and reduced token spend by 42%, enabling faster iteration on production models."

Also — yes, please cc me on the final slide before its publicly distributed. No legal redlines from our side for basic sales enablement.

—
Erik

Erik — thanks again, truly appreciate it.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Ben will finalize the one-pager and export a slide for our sales pack (internal only).
- Ill email a non-public PDF of the final slide and one-pager for your records and confirmation (ccd to your marketing lead if requested).
- Well also add the short script to the rep playbook and label the asset as Sparklytics (approved 5/18) in our internal library.

If you want to tweak the short script at all, tell me and well only use the approved wording. Otherwise Ill lock and move to internal distribution Monday.

Appreciate the partnership — excited to show Sparklytics as a production success story.

Sofia
